notes: Heartfire Immolator: '{R}, Sacrifice this creature: It deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker.' Targeting itself is legal when the ability is activated (CR 602.2b: targets before costs); the cost then sacrifices it, so at resolution its only target is illegal and the ability does not resolve (CR 608.2b): no damage is dealt. The engine used to mark 2 damage on the card in the graveyard.
